question.value: What is the sulphur-bearing molecule inventory at ~60 au from IRAS 16293-2422 B, and how do its molecular ratios compare with those of comet 67P/C-G measured by ROSINA?

evidence.quote: ALMA Band $7$ data from the large unbiased Protostellar Interferometric Line Survey (PILS) are used to search for S-bearing molecules in the outer disc-like structure, $\sim 60$ au from IRAS 16293–2422 B
project-id: 2013.1.00278.S, PI: Jes K. Jørgensen
carried out with ALMA in the $329-363$ GHz frequency range (Band $7$)
with a spectral resolution of $0.2$ km s$^{-1}$
The observations are a combination of the $12$- and the $7$-m dish arrays
Here, the dataset convolved with a uniform circular restoring beam of $0\ensuremath{''}{5}$ is used.
ensuring that the emission on scales up to $\sim13\ensuremath{''}$ is recovered

sensitivity.value: sigma = 10 mJy/beam/channel or 5 mJy/beam km/s adopted

evidence.quote: Hereafter, $\sigma=10$ mJy beam$^{-1}$ channel$^{-1}$ or $5$ mJy beam$^{-1}$ km s$^{-1}$ is adopted.
Subsequently, ratios between various molecules are compared to those deduced for the coma gases of 67P/C–G, as measured with the ROSINA instrument
The cometary values correspond to bulk coma quantities measured with DFMS/ROSINA

findings_qualitative.value: IRAS 16293 B has much more OCS relative to H2S than 67P/C-G; SO/SO2 agrees

claims.hypothesis: Do S-bearing ratios in IRAS 16293 B match 67P/C-G?
claims.experiment: LTE fits of PILS Band 7 at one-beam offset, compared with ROSINA ratios
claims.result: OCS/H2S factor 3~33 higher; SO and SO2 lower relative to H2S; SO/SO2 0.33 vs 0.4-0.7
claims.finding: Differences possibly from UV levels and birth-cloud temperature

evidence.quote: for OCS the ratio relative to H$_{2}$S for IRAS 16293–2422 B is a factor of $3 \sim 33$ higher than that for 67P/C–G

why_this_data.value: Source B lines are narrower, giving less blending, ideal for isotopologues

evidence.quote: The choice to focus on source B has been made, because its lines are much narrower than those observed towards source A

limitations_admitted.value: H2S column uncertain by an order of magnitude due to unknown HDS/H2S
